description: Returns OpenAccountants' two plans and how to reach the team. Free: 100 questions a month for individuals and teams of 5 or fewer, with every skill and calculator. Team: for finance teams, accounting firms and larger organisations; no monthly cap, team accounts and custom builds into existing workflows, including agents on the ledger and tools the team already uses (Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, NetSuite and others); priced for each team, so no amount is returned. Also returns the pricing page, the contact link and an email address. OpenAccountants does not provide accounting services.
